_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.20 (build 87512, linux64, headless), read out of the running game with gdb rather than through Lua, on the CHUNK GRID: two quick_multioctave_noise and two variable_persistence_multioctave_noise expressions routed to Nauvis's aux, temperature, elevation and moisture during a --create, nine chunks each. Quick: every grid basis_noise kernel call its octaves made (origin x0, y0, step, input and output scale as the game passed them), chained by buffer content, and `values`, the shared buffer after the last octave. Variable persistence: the op's own constants as its run read them (`fields`) and `values`, its output register when run returned. `values` is 1,024 floats, row-major, row r and column i being world tile (x + i, y + r). Cross-checked: 2.0.77 (build 84539, linux64, headless) returned bit-identical values. Captured by scripts/probes/quick-vp-grid (#451). Graded by crates/fmw-noise/src/fixtures.rs.
